basis: Source review only. These assessments establish no API or behavioral passes. Package-level labels do not exclude portable assertions.

packages.reason: The package uses the Go implementation. Supplied executables and malformed inputs have original upstream coverage.
packages.next_action: Preserve native executable fixtures and parser coverage as SDK sources change.
packages.targets: ReaderAt accepts caller-supplied bytes. File access requires a native target.

packages.reason: Public variables, JSON, and handler logic are portable. The default memstats variable depends on native Go heap counters.
packages.next_action: Separate portable variables from runtime memory semantics. Do not invent native heap measurements.
packages.targets: Variables can work on all targets. HTTP serving requires VM/AOT.

packages.reason: The package uses the Go gc, gccgo, and source importer implementations. Default selects the gc export format of the selected SDK. Source imports use the caller build context.
packages.next_action: Preserve byte-based custom lookup and selected SDK source inputs. Review full importer suites and future SDK export formats.
packages.targets: Custom gc export-data lookup uses caller-supplied bytes on all targets. SDK files and compiler subprocesses require VM/AOT. Source analysis can use SDK cgo tools. Gart cgo execution remains unsupported.

packages.reason: FastCGI records, request conversion, and supplied listeners use the original Go implementation. Inherited listener descriptors remain unsupported.
packages.next_action: Validate inherited descriptor adapters without changes to the supplied-listener protocol or original assertions.
packages.targets: VM/AOT can host listeners. Browser HTTP servers remain outside the target contract.

packages.reason: HTTP handler logic is portable. Profile data and trace endpoints depend on runtime/pprof and runtime/trace.
packages.next_action: Resolve runtime profile contracts before exposing successful profile endpoints.
packages.targets: VM/AOT can host HTTP. Browser server endpoints are unavailable.

packages.reason: Pure-Go lookup can parse passwd/group files. Native account services and current-user identity need platform adapters.
packages.next_action: Use original osusergo parser assertions, then validate host account lookup separately.
packages.targets: VM/AOT host adapters are feasible. Browsers have no equivalent host account database.

packages.reason: Open loads native Go shared objects with the native Go runtime and ABI. Dart cannot execute these objects as Go plugins.
packages.next_action: Keep native Go shared-object loading outside the declared subset.
packages.targets: Native Go plugin loading is outside all current targets.

packages.reason: This package supports native Go/C calls and the native Go runtime. The declared subset excludes cgo.
packages.next_action: Retain the explicit cgo exclusion. A standalone handle table would not establish cgo compatibility.
packages.targets: cgo is outside all current targets.

packages.reason: The API writes compiler coverage metadata and counter files. Existing Gart test coverage does not establish this binary format or counter contract.
packages.next_action: Assess compiler instrumentation and original Go coverage format readers before implementation.
packages.targets: Byte writers could work on all targets. Directory operations require file access.

packages.reason: Value access and GODEBUG event counters have a portable implementation. Native Go heap, scheduler, and collector measurements have no direct Dart equivalent.
packages.next_action: Retain original portable assertions and the private metric-registry blocker. Add only measurements with a truthful runtime definition.
packages.targets: Value APIs can work on all targets. Native Go runtime measurements have no direct Dart equivalent.

packages.reason: Labels and profile serialization can be portable. Native CPU sampling, heap profiles, and stack collection require different runtime support.
packages.next_action: Separate labels, user profiles, serialization, and native profile capture.
packages.targets: Portable metadata can work on all targets. Native Go profile capture does not transfer directly.

packages.reason: This package links native race instrumentation and platform runtime objects. It is not a portable public assertion library.
packages.next_action: Keep the native race runtime outside the current cooperative-isolate contract.
packages.targets: Native Go race instrumentation is outside all current targets.

packages.reason: Task metadata and user events can be portable. Scheduler events and flight-recorder bytes require runtime instrumentation and Go trace-format support.
packages.next_action: Separate context/task semantics from event capture and native scheduler semantics.
packages.targets: Metadata can work on all targets. Event capture needs target-specific instrumentation.

packages.reason: HostLayout promises host C ABI layout. Dart object layout does not satisfy this promise.
packages.next_action: Reject the native layout contract. Do not accept the marker as evidence of layout compatibility.
packages.targets: Host C ABI layout is outside all current targets.

packages.reason: Constant layout queries use compiler type information. Raw pointer access remains outside the subset.
packages.next_action: Validate generic layouts and preserve the raw memory exclusion.
packages.targets: Compile-time queries work across Dart targets. Native memory operations remain excluded.
